title: Site Engineers Civils and Structures
abstract: Are you a Site Engineer with experience in Civils and or Structures??
bullets: Join a global leader in Sustainable Infrastructure
content_text:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing to our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges, including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future.
About the Project:
Acciona as part of the ActivUS Alliance is nearing the delivery phase of The Logan and Gold Coast Faster Rail (LGC) Project, which will double the number of rail tracks and upgrade stations for a 20 kilometer section of the Beenleigh and Gold Coast lines between Kuraby, a suburb south of Brisbane's CBD, and Beenleigh, a suburb of Logan City.
About the Opportunity:
ACCIONA is actively seeking additional Site Engineers to join the team.
Opportunities exist across the following disciplines:
- Rail Civil
- Civil Engineering
- Structural Engineering
As part of our team, you will contribute to the planning, coordination, and delivery of major works within a diverse engineering environment on one of QLD's most significant rail infrastructure projects.
Key Accountabilities
- Drive a positive safety culture while ensuring rigorous adherence to safety, quality, and environmental requirements.
- Deliver works to project specifications, standards, and technical requirements
- Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, and construction activities
- Support design reviews, technical assessments, and constructability inputs
- Prepare progress reports, project documentation, and engineering records
- Drive innovation, continuous improvement, and technical excellence across your discipline
Capability and Experience we are looking for:
- Degree in Civil, Structural, or related Engineering discipline
- Experience on major infrastructure projects
- Strong coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills
- Ability to manage safety, compliance, and project standards
- Problem-solving mind-set and commitment to safe, sustainable engineering delivery
What we Offer:
- Opportunity to work on a landmark infrastructure project shaping QLD's future
- Exposure to complex civil and structural challenges
- Career development through ACCIONA's global training and development programs
- Collaborative, high-performing team culture
At ACCIONA, we offer a dynamic and challenging work environment where our employees can grow and develop their careers. We provide opportunities for professional development, and our team members are encouraged to bring new ideas and approaches to their work. Our company is dedicated to fostering a culture of inclusiveness and respect where every employee feels valued and supported.
Apply now!
